profile.name: Priyansh Gupta
profile.heroSubtitle: AI Engineer and Full-Stack Developer building production-ready AI applications, agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and modern web products.

contact.availability: Open to opportunities in AI engineering, software engineering, and building intelligent products.

projects.title: Doc Query
projects.description: A document question-answering platform that lets users upload documents and interact with their content using retrieval-augmented generation. The system handles document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and grounded LLM responses.

projects.title: Multimodal RAG Workspace
projects.description: An end-to-end workspace for asking questions about complex PDFs containing text, tables, charts, diagrams, and images. It extracts document content, uses vision-powered descriptions to make visual information retrievable, searches semantically, and streams grounded answers with citations.

projects.title: Agentic Chatbot
projects.description: An agentic conversational AI system capable of combining RAG with dynamic tool calling. The chatbot can retrieve information from documents, invoke external tools, maintain conversational context, and stream responses to users.

projects.title: SQL Bot
projects.description: A conversational database interface where users provide their SQL database connection and chat directly with their data. The AI understands database schemas, generates SQL queries, executes them against the connected database, and explains the results in natural language.

projects.title: AI Expense Tracker
projects.description: An intelligent expense tracking application where users upload receipts and automatically extract structured expense information. PaddleOCR handles receipt text extraction, while AI processes the extracted information into useful expense data that users can also explore conversationally.

skills.designIntro: I build interfaces where the frontend is tightly connected to the underlying product and AI experience — from conversational UIs to data-heavy dashboards and document workflows.
skills.backendIntro: I build backend systems around APIs, databases, asynchronous processing, and AI workloads, with a focus on architectures that can move from prototype to production.
skills.exploringIntro: My strongest focus is AI engineering — building systems around LLMs rather than simply calling an API. I work across RAG, agents, tool calling, multimodal retrieval, OCR, and LLM infrastructure.

experience.summary: Working across AI engineering and full-stack development, building intelligent applications involving RAG, conversational AI, agents, document processing, database interaction, and modern web systems.
Built software products across frontend and backend systems while developing a strong engineering foundation across web applications, APIs, databases, and full-stack product development.

certifications.title: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations
certifications.description: A solution-architecture credential focused on designing and building production-grade applications with Claude using Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, the Claude API, and MCP.
